requirements: Complete pinned source tree and generated build recipe; no guessed CMake route for the Eclipse-only snapshot
Pinned compiler/linker, flags and every dependency ABI/artifact hash, license and source notice
OpenBabel 2.x include ABI in .cproject is not established by modern source providers

effective_policy.syntax: Verify every argument against the selected executable help before use; argv is a prospective source-derived template.
effective_policy.databases: One new database and one original single-record SDF per case, serial; no file concatenation.
effective_policy.limits: No conformer reduction (0); explicit UINT_MAX output/orientation cap, not mathematically infinite. Reaching any cap or failure prevents complete-negative acceptance.
effective_policy.max_rmsd: 0.3125 angstrom, equal to the common physical radius; a complete equal-radius per-site interior placement necessarily satisfies this RMSD bound. No unequal-radius or numerical-boundary comparison.
effective_policy.identity: Each case DB contains one input record/one conformer; preserve external molid/location separately from original case/atom identities.
effective_policy.title: Disconnected three-component exports have empty titles. r95 groups sequential equal titles as conformers; per-case DB prevents accidental cross-case grouping without editing molecular files.
effective_policy.threads: nthreads=1 still has main/coordinator/worker threads; multiple dbdir values can fork creators and multiply loading/query threads. One database per process plus CPU affinity, actual task monitoring and imposed resource limits; no claim of one total task.

observation_gates.state: received in source; installed receiving separate
observation_gates.requirement: Original record graph, Na/K/Li order, +1 charges, no bonds, one frame; original P1 1e-12nm absolute readback tolerance; source untouched.
Exact path/hash/build context, same path checked and executed, qualified help/definitions.

Complete actual feature output: three PositiveIon size1 centers, no extras. Native memberships need diagnostics; JSON has no atom indices. Coordinate association is derived evidence, not emitted membership.
Each original record imported/indexed/searchable exactly once; one conformer, zero omissions and retained precision/feature definitions.
Normal completion, effective caps below neither coverage nor output; all native placement mappings/distances if observable; original raw stdout/stderr/SDF immutable.

Stock CSV/SDF omit complete correspondences; do not label derived fitted-coordinate association as native atom/feature mapping. Full P1 mapping acceptance requires an admitted diagnostic path or an explicitly distinct reduced-scope case.
